_help: Property ids must match PROPERTIES in site/index.html. 'match' lists text found in the listing name or ID in your exports, or in the export's file name. hosting_since is the first bookable day, used for occupancy. A home rented room by room counts as occupied on any night at least one room is booked.

marketing_costs._help: What a campaign (or a source) cost in USD, for cost per booking on the marketing dashboard. Keys: a campaign name from the link builder, a source like facebook, or furnished-finder (the yearly fee for all three listings, for cost per lease).

public._help: What may appear on ntstays.com. Revenue never does.
public._hide_help: Names to hide in published reviews; they become [our host].
public._feature_help: Reservation codes of reviews to show on the website (see 'All reviews' in the dashboard). Only 4-star-and-up reviews are shown.
